cadastro_publico.py is ~770 lines mixing public + owner endpoints. Consider splitting into cadastro_publico_publico.py and cadastro_publico_admin.py for maintainability.
In enviar_solicitacao, _arquivos_pendentes is created via `locals()` check — brittle. Initialize as {} at function top.
